validation.bodyContainmentMethod: Actual closed horizontal skin contour containment; double skin shell is not treated as a solid volume.

limitations: The source atlas contains no vagus nerve mesh; these points are not patient anatomy.
Cervical positions vary; the carotid-sheath reference is not universal.
Branching, nodose ganglia and microscopic gut terminals are not resolved.
Distal gastric/celiac branches are landmark references; gut microterminals are unresolved and no direct intestinal shortcut is appended.
Left/right fibers mix in the esophageal plexus; lines do not trace individual axons.
Displayed 2 mm diameter is an illustrative millimeter-scale caliber, not a uniform measured diameter.

circulation.interSegmentPolicy: Hide moving markers between source vessels. Never draw bridging lines/tubes or interpolate unresolved steps.
circulation.hormoneSurvival: Only a fraction of endogenous active GLP-1 reaches systemic circulation; tracer quantity is not concentration or mass conservation.
circulation.forbiddenShortcut: No direct intestinal-to-pancreas blood vessel; no hormone particles moving inside nerves.

displayContract.blood: Highlight existing source mesh with a travelling emissive patch, optionally add <=0.25 mm-radius lumen marker.
displayContract.nerve: Reference nerve diameter 2 mm at world scale, afferent light travelling toward medulla; no centimetre-scale enlargement.
